raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector, rolled out 2026-01-17, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats both as local, so v2 rows land 6 hours late and evening transactions spill into the next day (the 36 rows on 2026-01-19 at 00:00-06:00). Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January) in silver_transactions fixes txn_ts and txn_date, and the gold tables rebuild from it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
